entry.title: EASD - Monthly Mule Runtime Patch on 22 Oct 2026, 16:00 - 18:00
entry.content:
THIS IS A SCHEDULED EVENT Oct 22, 16:00 - 18:00 PDT

Oct 22, 13:03 PDT
Scheduled - All Mule applications will undergo maintenance on 22 Oct 2026, from 16:00 to 18:00.

No outage is expected.

This work is being performed after hours to minimize any potential impact. In the unlikely event that an application is affected during patching, there may be a brief disruption of 15 to 30 minutes. All services will return to normal automatically once the maintenance is complete.

Please be aware that:

Some system functions may be temporarily unavailable.
API requests may not go through during part of the upgrade.
Processing of SFTP files will pause during deployment and resume automatically afterward.
All services will restore themselves without any action required on your part.

Applications that may be impacted:

Workday
Tuition Waiver (SFDC - TW)
EMMS (PlanOn)
Office of Research Services - Survey Monkey
OpenAthens
LinkedIn Learning Students
Lifeworks

IAM APIs will be impacted. This change is not only for web applications.
All APIs including IAM related will be impacted

- Students, applicants, alumni
- LLIS learners
All IAM related processes, and authentication access will be unavailable to:
- Applicant Service Centre (ASC)
- CWL Account Upgrader (CWLU)
- DAF website
- DeDupe website
- PHUB-admin website
- Science One
- UNI CRM
- UBC Student Housing and Community Services myAccount (including UBC Card)

No other impact on end users.

entry.title: EASD Rundeck Scheduler Platform Maintenance - 22 Oct 2026 11:00 AM to 22 Oct 2026 12:00 PM PT.
entry.content:
Oct 22, 13:15 PDT
In progress - Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.

Oct 22, 13:12 PDT
Scheduled - The Rundeck Scheduler Platform will undergo routine maintenance from 22 Oct 2026 11:00 to 22 Oct 2026 12:00 PT to maintain platform reliability and ensure accurate job scheduling following British Columbia's transition to permanent UTC-7 (America/Vancouver).

A brief service interruption of up to 5 minutes is expected while the Production environment is restarted.

Service Impact:

Rundeck may be temporarily unavailable during the maintenance window.

Any jobs running at the time of the restart will be interrupted and may require re-execution.

Jobs scheduled during the brief outage may be delayed. These jobs will be reviewed following the maintenance activity to ensure successful completion.

No action is required from users. Service will resume automatically following the maintenance activity.



Release Plan: https://confluence.it.ubc.ca/x/OFj4G

entry.content:

Completed - The scheduled maintenance has been completed.

Oct 20, 16:00 PDT
In progress - Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.

Scheduled - UBC IT managed PCs will be targeted with a silent package that will transition Windows OS to the new BC time zone (UTC-07:00) Pacific Time (British Columbia). For Windows OS PCs that have Location Services and Set time zone automatically turned on, the time zone change will be controlled by the OS. For all other scenarios the silent package will take care of setting the time zone to (UTC-07:00) Pacific Time (British Columbia), or (UTC-07:00) Yukon, depending on the availability of the new time zone to the OS which was made available via the Oct 13, 2026 Windows Cumulative Security Updates. We realize this may impact a small number of devices operating outside BC (Washington, Oregon, California) that may need to be corrected after this change.

Scheduled - UBC ARC Sockeye will be unavailable on Tuesday, October 20 from 09:00 until 18:00 PT for scheduled maintenance.

User Impact:

1. During this time, you will be unable to log in or transfer data to/from Sockeye, OnDemand, and Chinook.

2. All jobs will be queued. The scheduler will not start any job if its requested walltime overlaps with the
maintenance window, even if resources are available. Only jobs expected to finish before downtime
begins will be scheduled, if resources allow.

3. In rare cases, running jobs may need to be resubmitted. Please checkpoint or complete your jobs before
the maintenance window to avoid lost progress, and check your job queue afterward.
